diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue of the breast
legend: Low power shows aggregates of small dark lymphocytes and numerous marginal zone cells with abundant pale cytoplasm.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue of the breast
legend: At the left of the image are larger lymphoid cells that represent reactive germinal-centre cells. To the right are smaller, more uniform, neoplastic marginal zone cells, which infiltrate among the germinal-centre cells (follicular colonization).

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue of the breast
legend: Higher magnification shows clusters of marginal zone cells with pale cytoplasm, small lymphocytes, and frequent plasma cells.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue of the breast
legend: There is strong immunostaining for CD20 in a vaguely nodular and diffuse pattern.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue of the breast
legend: There are scattered and clustered CD3+ T cells, representing a minority of the lymphoid cells present.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue of the breast
legend: Immunohistochemistry shows kappa monotypic plasma cells, indicating plasmacytic differentiation in the clonal lymphoma population.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue of the breast
legend: Immunohistochemistry in the same case shows only rare lambda positive plasma cells that are not part of the neoplastic population.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue of the breast
legend: The Ki-67 proliferation index in EMZL is generally low, as is seen in this case. Proliferating cells may represent remnant germinal-centre cells of colonized follicles, especially when present in clusters. These should not be mistakenly interpreted as foci of large cell transformation.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue
legend: Low magnification shows a vaguely nodular and diffuse proliferation of lymphoid cells which formed a mass lesion in the breast.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue
legend: Most cells are marginal zone cells with oval to slightly irregular nuclei, smooth chromatin, and moderately abundant pale cytoplasm. A poorly defined reactive germinal centre, not associated with a follicle mantle and composed of larger cells with frequent mitoses, is seen in the right side of the image.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue
legend: In addition to marginal zone cells, there are scattered plasma cells and a few large lymphoid cells.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue
legend: Many plasma cells are kappa-positive. (Immunostain for immunoglobulin κ light chain)

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue
legend: In contrast, there is no staining for lambda. (Immunostain for immunoglobulin λ light chain)

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue
legend: Plasma cells and B cells are IgM-positive. The findings are consistent with a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, IgM kappa-positive. (Immunostain for IgM heavy chain)

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma)
legend: Low grade lymphoma of the breast showing patchy and sometimes coalescent aggregates of small to medium sized lymphoid cells within fibrous parenchyma. Immunohistochemical workup confirmed an extranodal marginal zone lymphoma.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue
legend: This extranodal marginal zone lymphoma is composed of marginal zone B cells, scattered plasma cells and few large lymphoid cells, along with many interspersed reactive follicles. Immunophenotyping showed a predominance of B cells (CD5-, CD10-) and plasmacytic differentiation (H&E stain).
